_comment: Copy to ~/.config/lmloop/model-budgets.json. Read by lmloop AND by the pi model-catalogue extension, so the two agree on how a model's real window is split. Both keep built-in defaults, so this file is a place to edit rather than a dependency — deleting it changes nothing.
_llama_swap_url: Where llama-swap serves. lmloop talks to it directly and never through a router: a router reports what a model advertises, not how the weights were loaded.
_headroom: Reserved for output when a model has no override below. A system prompt and tool definitions escape whatever budget an agent compacts to, so the declared window sits below the real one.
_output_override: Per-model output budgets, for models the default split is wrong for. `headroom` assumes the prompt runs out first; for a reasoning model it is the other way round — one spent a whole iteration deliberating and hit the 8192 cap mid-sentence without calling a tool. An override replaces headroom on BOTH sides, so contextWindow + maxTokens still lands exactly on the real window. Example: {"my-27b-model": 24576}
_unmeasured_context: Declared for a model with no measurement, small enough that no llama.cpp deployment rejects it.
_local_provider: Which provider prefix means a local server whose real window this machine can measure for itself. Everything that reads /running, parses a --ctx-size, or trusts the context cache applies to this provider and no other. Set it to "" if you have no local server: the local path turns off completely and every model's metadata comes from the agent's own config, the way a router-backed model's already does.
